bin_path.description: Absolute path to the tcpbench executable.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote tcpbench server.

port.description: Port number for the test stream.

duration.description: Duration of the benchmark in seconds. 0 for infinite.

interval.description: Statistics reporting interval in milliseconds. 0 disables output.

ip_version.description: IP version enforcement: '4' for IPv4, '6' for IPv6, empty for auto-detect.

buf_size.description: Size of the internal read/write buffer in bytes.

k_vars.description: Comma-separated list of kernel variables to monitor (TCP only).

source_addr.description: Source IP address to bind packets to.

sock_buf_size.description: Socket buffer size in bytes. 0 uses system default.

tos_keyword.description: TOS/DS Code Point value or keyword (e.g., 'throughput', 'lowdelay', 'cs0').
